import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a comprehensive dashboard-style visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Top left: Revenue by Product
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_revenue.index, product_revenue.values, color=colors[:len(product_revenue)])
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Revenue by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
# Add value labels
for i, (idx, val) in enumerate(product_revenue.items()):
    ax1.text(val, i, f' ${val:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=10)

# 2. Top right: Sales by Age Group and Payment Method
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_payment = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'payment_method'])['total'].sum().unstack()
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_payment = age_payment.reindex(age_order)
age_payment.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, width=0.8, color=sns.color_palette("Set2"))
ax2.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Revenue by Age Group and Payment Method', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend(title='Payment Method', title_fontsize=11, fontsize=10)
ax2.set_xticklabels(ax2.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Bottom left: Size preference distribution
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
size_counts = df['size'].value_counts()
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_counts = size_counts.reindex(size_order)
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(size_counts.values, labels=size_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                      startangle=90, colors=sns.color_palette("pastel")[:3],
                                      textprops={'fontsize': 11, 'fontweight': 'bold'})
ax3.set_title('Product Size Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
# Make percentage text more visible
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontsize(12)

# 4. Bottom right: Takeaway vs Dine-in comparison
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Calculate metrics
takeaway_stats = df.groupby('is_takeaway').agg({
    'total': ['sum', 'mean', 'count']
}).round(2)

# Create grouped bar chart
x = np.arange(2)
width = 0.25

takeaway_labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
total_revenue = [takeaway_stats.loc[0, ('total', 'sum')], takeaway_stats.loc[1, ('total', 'sum')]]
avg_transaction = [takeaway_stats.loc[0, ('total', 'mean')], takeaway_stats.loc[1, ('total', 'mean')]]
num_transactions = [takeaway_stats.loc[0, ('total', 'count')], takeaway_stats.loc[1, ('total', 'count')]]

# Normalize for visualization
bars1 = ax4.bar(x - width, [total_revenue[0]/1000, total_revenue[1]/1000], width, 
                label='Total Revenue (x$1000)', color=colors[0], alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax4.bar(x, avg_transaction, width, 
                label='Avg Transaction ($)', color=colors[2], alpha=0.8)
bars3 = ax4.bar(x + width, [num_transactions[0]/100, num_transactions[1]/100], width, 
                label='# Transactions (x100)', color=colors[4], alpha=0.8)

ax4.set_xlabel('Service Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Value', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Analysis', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.set_xticks(x)
ax4.set_xticklabels(takeaway_labels, fontsize=11)
ax4.legend(fontsize=10, loc='upper left')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Add value labels on bars
for bars in [bars1, bars2, bars3]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
                f'{height:.1f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
